{'text': '法國示威期間拍攝的片段顯示，一名 Apple 商店幾乎遭洗劫一空，現場一片混亂，並有汽車被縱火。', 'paragraph_context': 'Video captured during the protests in France show an Apple store being almost completely emptied by looters amid chaotic scenes that include cars being set alight.'}

{'text': '報道稱，波爾多和里爾的 Apple 商店遭洗劫者闖入，公眾騷亂仍在持續。這場騷亂最初是為抗議學校人滿為患、人手不足……', 'paragraph_context': 'Reports say that looters broke into Apple stores in Bordeaux and Lille as public unrest continues in what began as protests against overcrowded schools with insufficient staffing …'}

{'text': 'Complex 報道稱，法國三個城市有多間豪華零售店遭洗劫者闖入，包括 Louis Vuitton、Hermès 和 Apple。', 'paragraph_context': 'Complex reports that a number of luxury retail stores were invaded by looters in three French cities, including Louis Vuitton, Hermes, and Apple.'}

{'text': '全國示威期間，洗劫者洗劫了波爾多的 Louis Vuitton 和 Apple 商店、里爾另一間 Apple 商店，以及馬賽一家 Hermès 精品店。騷亂亦損壞了市政建築和政府辦公室、焚燒車輛，並導致約 1,200 人被捕；參與人數估計介乎 55 萬至 80 萬之間。', 'paragraph_context': 'Looters ransacked Louis Vuitton and Apple stores in Bordeaux, another Apple location in Lille, and a Hermès boutique in Marseille during nationwide protests. The unrest also damaged municipal buildings and government offices, set vehicles ablaze, and led to roughly 1,200 arrests as turnout estimates ranged from 550,000 to 800,000.'}

{'text': 'Olive8Ball 的置頂留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Olive8Ball'}

{'text': '相片中的賊人手上有一部 Studio Display？它會被變磚嗎？有人知道嗎？我知道示範產品如果運行演示操作系統軟件，都會被變磚，顯示器是否也包括在內？我希望這些卑劣行為會反噬他們。', 'paragraph_context': 'In the picture, the thief has a Studio Display? Will that be bricked? Does anyone know? I’m aware that demo products that run a demo OS software all get bricked, does that include displays? As I hope these vile acts backfire on them.'}

{'text': '該媒體在 Instagram 帳戶發布了一組相片和短片。其中一張相片顯示一名洗劫者扛着 Studio Display 沿街而行，片段則顯示洗劫者正在一家幾乎被清空的 Apple Store 內走動。', 'paragraph_context': 'The publication posted a carousel of photos and video clips on its Instagram account. One photo shows a looter carrying a Studio Display down the street, while a video clip shows an almost empty Apple Store as looters move through it.'}

{'text': '偷走展示產品的人會失望：這些產品設有自毀開關，一旦離開店舖的 Wi-Fi 覆蓋範圍，就會被變磚。此後唯一能做的事，就是回應 Find My。', 'paragraph_context': 'Those stealing display products will be disappointed: they are configured with a kill switch that bricks them once they leave the store Wi-Fi coverage. The only thing they will do from that point onward is respond to Find My.'}

{'text': '法國總統 Emmanuel Macron 譴責暴力和盜竊行為，表示「共和國絕不容忍暴力」，並承諾確保罪犯受檢控及懲處。', 'paragraph_context': 'The violence and theft has been condemned by French President Emmanuel Macron, who said that “there is no room for violence in our Republic,” promising to ensure that offenders will be prosecuted and punished.'}
